is_anopheles.evidence: The study analyzed whole-genome sequencing data of Anopheles darlingi mosquitoes from Brazil (Page 1, Title and Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper screened for target-site mutations in ace-1, gste2, rdl, and vgsc, but found none of the canonical target-site resistance markers listed in the inclusion criteria (Page 2, 'No SNPs previously associated with insecticide resistance were detected').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype/allele frequencies for any listed target resistance markers were reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected from Candeias do Jamari and Porto Velho in Rondônia State, Brazil, South America (Page 2, Results).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting novel whole-genome sequencing data of wild-caught and colony An. darlingi mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected in Candeias do Jamari and Porto Velho, Rondônia State, Brazil (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Wild-caught mosquitoes were collected during 2018–2019 (Page 8, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study presents novel whole-genome sequencing data generated for this study (NCBI BioProject PRJEB66076).

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files were not required as the study is ineligible based on study region.

assessment.summary: This study performed whole-genome sequencing on 20 wild-caught and 8 colony Anopheles darlingi mosquitoes from Rondônia State, Brazil, to investigate genetic diversity, population structure, and potential insecticide resistance mechanisms. No known target-site resistance mutations were detected.
exclusion_reasons: Not an African field population (study conducted on Anopheles darlingi in Rondônia State, Brazil).
Does not report genotype data for any of the required target resistance markers.
